timeline.sql: SELECT notebooks.*, u.username AS _owner_username, COALESCE(ip.indexing_pipeline_id,'') AS _published_pipeline_id,COALESCE(ip.indexing_pipeline_version,'builtin.chunk.v1') AS _published_pipeline_version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants ng WHERE ng.notebook_id = notebooks.id AND ng.principal_type IN ('group', 'group_admins')) AS _shared_to_groups FROM notebooks LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = notebooks.created_by LEFT JOIN unified_kg_state ip ON ip.notebook_id=notebooks.id WHERE notebooks.id = 'nb-missing' AND notebooks.status NOT IN ('copying','deleting','importing')
